difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the auxiliary category attached to an object and a functor commuting with fibre products and equalizers is almost directed (statement lines 633-640). The proof verifies the two defining conditions: for the first, given three objects and the corresponding morphisms, the fibre product of two of the source objects provides the required common refinement, with the author recording that the verification is omitted (proof lines 646-655); for the second, given two parallel morphisms their equalizer in the source category provides the required equalizing object, using compatibility with equalizers (proof lines 658-665). The non-formal content is the two constructions. The claim is H1/H2: two short verifications with the routine check noted.
